title: Track record (Contract C, v2)
description: Produced by component 1 alongside events. This is what draws the boxes. One object per track in tracks.jsonl.

team_confidence.description: How sure bumper OCR is about the WHOLE track's identity. Separate from per-event confidence; this is what flags a likely misattribution.

gaps.description: REQUIRED, possibly empty. Intervals where the robot was not observed. Consumers must not interpolate across a listed gap -- without this a four-second hole is indistinguishable from a low sample rate, and the overlay draws a robot gliding through footage nobody analyzed. Tracks are NOT split at gaps: re-identification exists to stitch fragments into one logical track.
